CHEF: Wears the tall white hat and runs the kitchen
NURSE: Holds the ward together, and Nightingale's calling
PILOT: Sits at the front and points out the wing
ACTOR: Learns the lines and hopes for a break a leg
BAKER: Up before dawn for the morning loaves
JUDGE: Wears the wig and has the last word
MEDIC: First on the scene when someone goes down
TUTOR: Teaches one to one, often after school
DOCTOR: Takes your pulse, and travels by TARDIS
DENTIST: Says open wide and asks about flossing
LAWYER: Objects, and bills by the hour
FARMER: Up with the animals, in at the harvest
WRITER: Stares at the blank page for a living
SINGER: Carries the tune and the tour
DANCER: Tells the story with the whole body
ARTIST: Works in paint, clay or anything else
BARBER: Cuts hair, and sings in a shop quartet
BUTCHER: Knows every cut of the animal
PLUMBER: Fixes the leak, and rescues a princess in Mario
BUILDER: Puts up the walls and the scaffolding
TEACHER: Sets the homework and marks it too
CLEANER: Leaves the place better than they found it
DRIVER: Behind the wheel, and a golf club
SAILOR: Works the deck and knows the knots
SOLDIER: Serves in uniform, and marches on
MECHANIC: Diagnoses the rattle under the bonnet
ENGINEER: Works out whether it will actually hold
SCIENTIST: Forms the hypothesis and tests it
LIBRARIAN: Keeps the catalogue and asks for quiet
FIREMAN: Slides the pole and holds the hose
POLICE: Blue lights, and the force you call at 999
PILOTS: More than one of the people at the controls
